project_type: Vite multi-page static site with Three.js 3D globe, GSAP scroll animations, and Lenis smooth scrolling
build_system: Vite 8 with multi-page input (index.html + species/*.html). Build uses rollup internally. No special quirks beyond large chunk warning for Three.js.
test_framework: No test framework - validation is via build success only
test_command: npm run build (no unit tests exist)
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build - must succeed with no errors. 2. Verify no import errors by checking for unresolved modules in build output.
environment_constraints: Node.js v22.22.3, npm 11.4.2 available. Network available for npm installs. No Docker daemon needed - static site only.
contribution_requirements: Light aesthetic (soft whites, pastels, translucent). Spring physics over linear easing. 60fps performance target. Mobile responsive with graceful degradation.
key_patterns: Entry points: src/main.js (homepage), src/species-page.js (species pages). 3D scene in src/cinematic-engine.js, globe in src/globe.js. CSS in src/style.css (homepage) and src/species-page.css (species). HTML pages: index.html + species/*.html. Globe uses HOTSPOTS array with lat/lng/ecosystem data. OverlayUI manages scroll-driven overlay visibility. GSAP ScrollTrigger with scrub for scroll-driven animations. Lenis for smooth scrolling connected to GSAP ticker.
directory_structure: Root: index.html, vite.config.js, package.json. src/: JS entry points and CSS. species/: individual HTML pages per species. public/data/: JSON data files for each species. dist/: build output.
